children.description: Label text. Falls back to the locale text composerInputAriaLabel when omitted, so the default is consistent with the textarea's aria-label.

classes.description: Override or extend the styles applied to the component.

htmlFor.description: The id of the textarea this label is associated with. Passed directly to the native htmlFor attribute. When provided, the label is semantically linked to the textarea so that clicking the label focuses the input and screen readers announce it on focus.

slotProps.description: The props used for each component slot.

sx.description: The system prop that allows defining system overrides as well as additional CSS styles.

slotDescriptions.label: The component that renders the label.
